candidate_workaround: Retry once with a bounded longer deadline and direct complete-file read; do not begin repository work until content is returned.
failure_signature: short wrapper timeout while reading a required complete skill file
recurrence_guard: Required skills and references must be read to EOF before repository commands; a timeout earns no partial credit.
rollback: Retain the negative and award no affected credit until the bounded recovery witness passes.
scope_boundary: Preferred only for the recorded owner-local trigger; no scientific, professional, production, authority, or independent-reproduction credit.
title: Use a bounded complete-file read after a short skill-read timeout
